name: Evaluations
summary: azure-ai-evaluation >=1.18.2: judge LLM via a `{byo_model, project_endpoint}` model_config (local + cloud evaluation jobs).
description: Prompty-based judge evaluators (`RelevanceEvaluator`, `CoherenceEvaluator`, `FluencyEvaluator`, etc.) accept a `model_config` dict shaped as `{"byo_model": "{connection}/{deployment}", "project_endpoint": "..."}`. When both keys are present, `azure-ai-evaluation` routes the judge call through the Foundry project Responses API (`_byo_judge.AsyncByoProjectResponsesClient`) instead of building a native `/openai/deployments/{deployment}/...` URL, so the AI Gateway connection is resolved server-side. Cloud-submitted evaluation jobs (`ProjectsClient.evaluations.create(...)`, the registry-evaluator + `initialization_parameters.deployment_name` shape used by the Foundry evaluation service) also accept a BYOM-prefixed `deployment_name` and run the judge call through the same gateway routing.
notes:
Fixed in `azure-ai-evaluation` 1.18.2 (2026-07-21 changelog: "Added support for admin-connected (BYO) judge models in prompty-based evaluators"). Verified live against a public (non-PE) Foundry + APIM AI Gateway pair with `azure-ai-evaluation==1.18.5`:

**Local synchronous evaluator:**
```python
model_config = {"byo_model": f"{apim_conn}/gpt-5-mini", "project_endpoint": project_endpoint}
RelevanceEvaluator(model_config=model_config)(query="What is 2+2?", response="4")
# -> {'relevance_result': 'pass', 'relevance_score': 4.0, ...}
```

**Cloud-submitted evaluation job** (registry evaluator `azureml://registries/azureml/evaluators/builtin.relevance/versions/12`, judge model passed via `initialization_parameters.deployment_name`):
```python
EvaluatorConfiguration(id="azureml://registries/azureml/evaluators/builtin.relevance/versions/12",
                        init_params={"deployment_name": f"{apim_conn}/gpt-5-mini"},
                        data_mapping={"query": "${data.query}", "response": "${data.response}"})
# job status -> 'Completed', evaluationMetrics: {"relevance.relevance_score": 4, "relevance.relevance_passed": 1, ...}
```

The *old* `AzureOpenAIModelConfiguration(azure_deployment="{conn}/{model}")` shape (local evaluator path only) is still broken on the same environment -- it builds `/openai/deployments/{conn}/{model}/chat/completions`, which Foundry rejects with `400 'API version not supported'`. `_BYOModelConfiguration` is not yet exported as a public type (SDK docstring: "not caller-facing... until the feature reaches GA"), so pass a plain dict with the two required keys, not the typed config classes.

Set `EVAL_JUDGE_MODEL` to run; requires `azure-ai-evaluation>=1.18.2`.
